evaluation.production: Strong TE1 production profile. Our 181.5 PPR median is essentially aligned with current consensus.
evaluation.ceiling: Top-six TE finish remains reachable if the red-zone role survives the coordinator change; 2025’s 11 TDs should not be treated as the median.
evaluation.role: Starting TE with a strong first-read/target-share history and a plausible No. 2 receiving role.
evaluation.environment: Hurts plus Philadelphia’s line and scoring infrastructure are clear positives.
evaluation.availability: Age 31 with a multi-year missed-game history lowers full-season confidence.
evaluation.reliability: Useful weekly TE1 floor, but 2025 scoring was unusually touchdown-driven.
evaluation.sustainability: Reception volume is sustainable; double-digit TD repetition is not the base case.
evaluation.price: At ADP 119 versus our Overall target 104, he is a value at current cost.

evaluation.production: Moderate-to-solid season-long production with a better early-season path than his market price implies.
evaluation.ceiling: The ceiling comes from hybrid receiving/rushing usage rather than a return to his 2021 target profile.
evaluation.role: Expected to work across receiver, backfield and return packages, with a credible WR2 role while Pearsall is out.
evaluation.environment: Returning to a system he knows is a major transition advantage; surrounding competition keeps it below elite.
evaluation.availability: Age 30 and a long physical-usage history create meaningful missed-time risk.
evaluation.reliability: 2025 showed a strong opening stretch followed by a second-half fade, so weekly consistency is not a strength.
evaluation.sustainability: YAC skill remains useful, but career trend and age argue against projecting a full rebound to peak Deebo.
evaluation.price: At ADP 130 versus our Overall target 118, the late-round price is favorable.

evaluation.production: Moderate PPR-flex production; the 2025 injury-shortened season is normalized per game rather than treated as a talent collapse.
evaluation.ceiling: A healthy season with receiving usage can still produce RB2 stretches, but workhorse volume is no longer a realistic base assumption.
evaluation.role: Committee back with Jordan Mason; strongest path to value is passing-down work and efficient touches.
evaluation.environment: Minnesota is a positive enough environment, but committee structure matters more than team scoring here.
evaluation.availability: Missed five games in 2025 with hamstring, shoulder and hip issues and enters his age-31/32 season; this is the main drag.
evaluation.reliability: Useful when active but reduced touch volume makes weekly outcomes more game-script dependent.
evaluation.sustainability: Receiving ability has held up better than early-down explosiveness; age-related decline is now a real projection input.
evaluation.price: ADP 119 is slightly ahead of our Overall target 128, so he is not a priority at market cost.
